notes: All five rectangle types present in both: basic red filled, square (red stroke only), rectangle with stroke (stacked red+blue), stroke dash (blue+red dashes), curved corners (dark blue pill)
C++ rectangles appear slightly narrower/smaller than MAUI's — shapes are right-aligned in C++ but left-aligned in MAUI, indicating HorizontalOptions difference
The 'A Rectangle with stroke' item in MAUI shows two stacked rects (empty red-bordered + solid blue); C++ renders the same but the top empty rect appears darker/filled in dark mode
Dark mode: C++ 'rectangle with stroke' top rect appears with a dark fill rather than fully transparent, differing from MAUI's empty (transparent) interior
